items.basis: Binding remains in the single canonical kernel/runtime path; no use-case-specific SWAP kernel created.
No file, format, path, parsing or unit-I/O dependency added to kernel execution.
H_budget is carried only by canonical numerical configuration; not physical parameters, forcing or committed physical state.
No persistent per-column physical state added; accepted derivative history remains the already-qualified numerical continuation state.
No Newton/Jacobian/constitutive scratch moved into column state; normalization is scalar worker/model execution data.
No storage-layout constraint or per-column heavyweight solver object introduced.
Certificate participates in checkpoint, trial, reject/rollback and explicit commit; rejected cases preserve physical state and accepted history bitwise.
Retries restore exact committed/checkpoint context; rejected trials do not publish history. No physical-origin shortcut added.
Budget normalization is independent of day/month/year semantics; transaction remains over generic t0,t1.
No coupling-window assumption added.
Transaction acceptance remains composable with coupling; this work unit does not implement coupling-specific policy.
No groundwater-interface semantics changed.
Hard mass gate remains independent and source-ordered before certificate acceptance; valid C_h cannot override mass failure.
No interface-sensitivity contract altered.
Normalization adds zero nonlinear and zero linear solves; underlying qualified indicator retains one defect TRIDAG with accepted history.
No per-column heavy solver allocation or MultiSWAP-incompatible state introduced.
No MODFLOW-cell/tile ownership added to SWAP.
No deep-vadose component or assumption added.
No component-transition storage handling changed.
Budget is carried generically and interpreted by the Richards backend, preserving alternative soil-water solver extensibility.
No crop, ET, drainage, irrigation or surface-process duplication introduced.
No consumer is coupled to HeadCalc internal arrays; normalization consumes the solver-owned B_inf diagnostic surface.
Physical configuration remains separate from numerical policy; H_budget is explicit numerical configuration and changes no physics option.
Retry count remains bounded by existing policy. No monotonicity assumption or unbounded tolerance controller added. Hard mass remains non-negotiable.
Reference Richards execution remains available and F-KT09/F-KT10 regressions pass.
Owner CI verifies raw B_inf, budget supplied/valid/value, C_h, certificate status/reason, attempts, retries, rollbacks and mass diagnostics.
No optional physical module receives unconditional memory or compute cost.
No runtime/coupler composition responsibility moved into SWAP kernel.
No default budget, midnight/day assumption, file-input assumption, MODFLOW assumption or hidden bootstrap introduced.
This file records the explicit architecture-invariant audit for the F-KT11 change.
